create_gym_env_list: create a list of gym environments using gym.make for parallel simulation
wrap_envs_with_gymenv: wrap multiple gym environments with GymEnv for batched step and reset operations
reset_gymenv: reset a GymEnv wrapper and retrieve initial observations and running status tensors
step_gymenv_with_dicttensor: step a GymEnv using a DictTensor action to advance all parallel environments
track_running_envs: track which environments are still running by inspecting the who_is_still_running tensor
